answer: Peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each identity holds one vertex, locks a 70-credit bond, files one fresh key-signed sonnet. A zephyr beacon draws a 5% sample each epoch; two auditors, each at a different vertex, check originality, and a copied sonnet burns the bond. First 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000, lock 70,000, chase 40,000. Rented sonnet rings share one writer, so one audit burns every linked bond. Honest agents pay 38 once.
